crossRefs.note: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.
She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.
but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends…
so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

translations.web: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.
translations.bsb: All the saints send you greetings, especially those from the household of Caesar.
translations.kjv: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.
translations.asv: All the saints salute you, especially they that are of Caesar's household.
